description: The slate is touched with years of handprints and a ring of rust flakes off the top of the hinges. The door continues, though, its stubborn assertion of 'in' and 'out'.

donor_reference.role: Actual DoorSimple_Mover supplies restrained planar shading and handle readability only. It is a rectangular moving panel, not an equivalent arched slate design. No donor sliding motion, wood appearance or mechanics is copied.

palette.ownership: Native runtime arch uses R255/detail, leaf R0/foreground; equal current colors do not erase these roles.

fit_contract.closed: Broad source slate within the fixed arch; left fixed jamb straps bridge to pivot barrels and moving slate straps; recessed handle on right.
fit_contract.open: Same leaf rotates 90 degrees about left hinge. Source edge remains left, straps connect barrel to fixed jamb. Broad face detail becomes occluded by real geometry.
fit_contract.frame: Common 16x24 source frame and anchor8,16; no fitting to individual state bounds.
fit_contract.depth: Frame, slab thickness and hardware dimensions are authored estimates.

selection: Retain direct Blender geometry and existing source surface with deterministic continuation/contours. No additional style generation was necessary.
